title: Iterator Adapters Warm-up
prompt:
Implement three small functions using iterator adapters (map, filter, fold, scan, zip, etc.) rather than index-based loops.

1. sum_sq_odds(v): the sum of squares of the odd numbers in v (negative odd numbers count too).
2. running_max(v): a Vec where element i is the maximum of v[0..=i]. Empty input gives an empty Vec.
3. pairwise_diffs(v): a Vec of v[i+1] - v[i] for each adjacent pair. Fewer than 2 elements gives an empty Vec.

Example:
  sum_sq_odds(&[1, 2, 3, -5]) -> 35
  running_max(&[3, 1, 4, 1, 5]) -> [3, 3, 4, 4, 5]
  pairwise_diffs(&[1, 4, 9, 16]) -> [3, 5, 7]
